_about: Recruiting calendar for Break into Wall Street (break-into-wall-street/recruiting-calendar/). One row per programme. status: confirmed (dates stated by the firm), expected (month window inferred from the last cycle, basis says how), rolling, unknown. A confirmed row shows its dates as confirmed only once verified is true: someone opened its source and saw the date, on the checked day. Never invent a date. See README, Recruiting calendar.
